notes: 02: no metadata fetch on save; title defaults to URL, description empty, no preview image; favicon is derived client-side from Google's service, not collected/stored from the page. 03: title/description are freely editable before and after save, but nothing is auto-collected to edit (partial). 04: url/title/description/tags editable via PUT, but there is no note field (partial). 06: createBookmark always INSERTs; no duplicate-url detection or convergence to edit. 10: tags are a plain text input with no autocomplete/datalist of existing tags. 12: search covers title/url/description (and tags), but there is no note field, so note is not searchable (partial). 14: no #tag search syntax; '#x' is matched only as a literal LIKE substring. 15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised group parsing. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match. 17-19: no unread/read-later state (only an out-of-spec 'favorite' flag). 20-21: no multi-select or bulk actions. 22: ordering is hardcoded (favorite DESC, updated_at DESC); no user-selectable sort key. 23: no markdown note field or rendering. 24-25: no local HTML/PDF or Internet Archive snapshot. 26-28: no archive state or archived list. 29: no saved bundles. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user display settings (sort/items/font size).
